question: Can the unchanged Q2.8 profile reach substantial quantity recovery before a stricter replay guard, under at most half of Q2.8's exposure?

changed: first-hit early stopping at 80% quantity recovery
replay hard guard tightened from 2% eligibility to 0.75%
unchanged: Q2.8 fixed graded-plasticity profile and coefficients
seed 2, batch size, deterministic sample order, learning rate, weight decay, and gradient clip
four deterministic measurement samples per range
complete-displacement profile scaling including weight decay
scientific_change.causal_scope: combined operational repair; it tests the preregistered stopping policy, not the individual effect of cadence, quantity threshold, or replay threshold

pilot.replay_samples_per_update: one from each of the six frozen replay training ranges

stop_rule.replay_comparator: greater than 0.0075 is an immediate no-go
stop_rule.quantity_comparator: greater than or equal to 0.8 freezes the current checkpoint
stop_rule.ranking: none; the first eligible measurement is the only candidate

allowed_before_candidate_freeze: Q2.8 historical aggregate evidence bound by this contract

language_gate.condition: exactly one first-hit checkpoint has been hash-frozen

decision_branches.replay_guard: record Q2.9 no-go and retire the profile family
decision_branches.no_first_hit_by_update100: record Q2.9 no-go and retire the profile family
decision_branches.candidate_frozen: stop training and require a separately bound unchanged language gate
decision_branches.language_gate_no_go: record Q2.9 no-go; keep seeds 1 and 3 sealed
decision_branches.language_gate_go: stop and require a separate three-seed replication contract; no seed-2 promotion

stop_conditions: any lineage, source, profile, data, authorization, or contract hash mismatch
a forbidden evaluation source is supplied before candidate freeze
a runtime input, seed, hyperparameter, threshold, or resume override is supplied
replay regression exceeds 0.75% at a frozen measurement
the first eligible checkpoint is frozen
